svg.title: DIA-005 · A governor, unpinned
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a steam engine. A boiler feeds steam through an open throttle valve to a cylinder and flywheel. A flyball governor spins above the steam pipe with its balls flung wide, but the rod that should connect it to the throttle is missing. A wire from the governor rings a bell instead, and a heap of coal waits by the firebox.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 5 · HOW THESE INTERACT
a. Boiler: capital and compute. b. Flywheel: capability, read as speed. c. Governor: oversight. The balls rise with visible harm.
d. Rod to the throttle: never pinned. e. Bell: rings on harm. f. Throttle: open. g. Coal: how the bell gets answered.
DIA-005 · Every part of a self-correcting engine is here and turning. The one rod that would let it slow itself was left off.
